notes.title: Speedball - September Update
notes.content:
Speedball - September Update
Ahead of Play vs Devs on Friday afternoon, we are releasing our latest update for Speedball.

With a fresh new look, and a host of new changes and features, it's time to get stuck back into the arena and become Speedball champion once again.

Here are a few highlights of what's new:
Invite a friend
Starting in this update, you can now invite a Steam friend to play against in Speedball.

Choose from a selection of pre-made teams, select your arena and you're ready to go!
Custom game rules
If you want to have a longer match with a friend or vs the CPU. You can now customise the match!

Boost the time to a lengthy 15 minutes, or increase the damage taking to a whopping 400%, and play the most brutal game of Speedball yet!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/306a9a8e0e6410224a0b51266ee0dc74f00aedbd.png"]


New Arenas
We have so many new arenas in this update, filling out the league mode roster with each team having their own arena with unique styles.
Team Traits
Teams in League mode and quickplay now have a trait to assist them in home arena games. Is there a team you have yet to try? Maybe give Rage 2000 a season with their increased damage on tackles!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/15ddabead696a0cd0997ae3315479b94f5119a15.png"]
Full additions and changes:
New UI - Front End and Match HUD have been updated

Invite friend - You can now make a private lobby for you and a friend to play Speedball with your rules!

New Tutorial Scenarios

Various AI Improvements

Two new teams available in Quick Play and Online Customisation options,

Ms Snuffle Piglets & The Judges

New Themed Arenas - BioPrime Lab, Favela and Subway Abandoned

New Arena Hazards - Ball Electrifier & Rebound Bumper

Reworked some arenas to have less hazards

These arenas now have a "Brutal" version, with all the hazards still included, for maximum injury opportunities!

Added Speedball Stadium

This new arena layout some dedicated fans may recognise from Speedball 2.

Added the Practice Stadium

This arena is Speedball at it's simplest, just two teams, two goals and a ball!


Join Our Discord
We’re seeking fan ideas and feedback on how to grow the game and encourage players to join Speedball's dedicated Discord forum to engage with our developers and contribute to the development cycle.

notes.title: Speedball - Coming Soon
notes.content:
Coming Soon: Play vs Developers
 The next update for Speedball is right around the corner, it's jam packed full of visual changes, new content and more! To make sure our players get the most of every part of this update, we are hosting a Play vs Developers event on our Discord.

 

Play the game between 3pm and 5pm BST next Friday (12th of September) and you will be queuing up against our dedicated developers. With a variety of skill level in the team you will be sure to have some fearsome matches in the arenas, Some come, test your mettle against the developers and show us your skills!


Update Sneak Peak
There is not long to wait for our next content update in Speedball. Here are a few new features and improvements coming in the next update.

 
New Arenas and Dangers
A taste of dirt, and a little bit more, that's all we can say for now...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/f541d3e64b47f98f0cf6d2fb9da84e7ea2659302.png"]
Online VS and Quickplay
Have you been wanting to play against a friend or change up the rules of the game?

You can now invite your friends with Speedball to play with you online via Steam! Choose your teams, the arena you want to play in and then customise the rules of the game to your liking to see who is the true Speedball champion of your friend group!

Menu and Style update
We've added a new layer of visual polish to our menus! The main menu now brings you straight into the world of Speedball!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/96fc5f05dc3f8d41a30a46d3cc4eb1b960055cea.jpg"]

There is plenty more coming with the update including changes to league mode, AI and difficulty tweaks to help you find the level of brutality you're looking for in the arena!

 
Feedback focus
After the next update, we will be looking at our community for your valuable input. Not only will we be keeping a keen eye on both the Steam forums and our Discord feedback space, but we will also be releasing a survey to get your feelings and thoughts on the latest gameplay changes and additions. This survey will be announced in the Discord, so be sure to join to get your opinion seen!

 
Join the Discord for more sneak peaks
In preparation for this next update we will be showing a few more upcoming changes and features in our dedicated Discord.

 

For all other latest news and updates be sure to follow Speedball on all our social channels: X, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.

notes.title: Speedball – League Mode Single Player Update
notes.content:
League Mode is here!
[previewyoutube=OdDTd6y_VzA;full][/previewyoutube]

In Speedball’s League Mode, 10 teams compete over a season to be crowned champions. To take your team of rookies to the top, you will need to grow a squad of up to 18 all-stars, and manage who you play, bench or rest for each game. Effectively rotating your players throughout the season will be key to managing the fatigue of your players and preventing injuries.

Pick your best team using each player’s set of unique stats (including shot power, speed, durability etc) and traits (such as pyromaniac, rioter, star shooter and pitcher). You will need to draft in new players throughout the season to bolster your ranks and replace your losses – remember, there are no-holds barred in the arena!

New Additions:
 League Mode
 Subway Arenas
 Grand Central
 King's Terminus   Vandal Hyper-Tracksuit Armour Stlye

notes.title: Speedball - Devlog
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/1cc7abcc2026c9364555154d04f78e47b7f718ba.jpg
Coming soon in Speedball

The journey so far
Since Speedball released in October 2024 into Early Access, we have:

 Introduced 6 new arenas
 Added many new game changing chaotic arena hazards
 Celebrated the Festive Free-For-All
 Brought in new customisable armours and styles
 Increased the speed of the game thanks to community feedback

With regular updates we have brought more flavour, colour and danger every month and with thanks to our community, we are building on all the feedback you have provided to plan the future of Speedball. 
As such, the next update is going to be a big one. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/a1412deb8d0a25bf04a9ce4c0fb3109ecbc6ef5d.png
What's coming?
Coming soon to an arena near you, we will be bringing you a brand new, much requested game mode!

In this mode you will pick your team and work your way through the Speedball League to crown yourself the Ultimate Speedball Champions!

With variable difficulty, you will see how far can go when you take it up to the hardest challenge. 
As the dangers become greater in the Speedball arena, your players will become battered, bruised and will need replacing! You will recruit new players with a variety of traits to give your team the edge in this brutal blood sport.

We’re still smelting all the balls we need and constructing our most exhilarating arena yet. But once the players are warmed up, and the paint is dry, we can’t wait to share this next milestone of an update with our players!

Until next time!

Let the speed, meet the ball! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/8bfed1ec4e66d21a0b5e083d044fc37f90dff014.png

notes.title: Speedball - Winter Update
notes.content:
Hey Folks!

Today marks the launch of the Winter Update for Speedball. This update introduces a slew of new content  for Speedball and continues to address the issues that have been highlighted by our dedicated community.

The winter update features a brand new arena, new dynamic arena elements, cosmetics and more! 
Read the full list below:

Patch Notes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/b8721b31716aae72012b66ce68e840f754d9a6fa.jpg

Newly added:

 New Arena 'Tundra Dome' added.
 New Dynamic Arena Element 'Ice Turret' added.
 Manager Level Cap raised.
 New Challenges added.
 Additional Armour colours added.

Bug Fixes:

 Resolved issue where players were unable to opt out of player analytics being recorded.
 Fixed issue where players could not access offline modes when playing offline.
 Resolved HUD error where a players star count would be affected when deactivating an opponents stars.
 Fixed bug where the ball would not reset when stuck outside the arena.
 Resolved bug where switching to a player you previously passed to would cause a loss of functionality.
 Player profile now updates correctly when scoring a goal.
 Resolved issue where adjusting game resolution to differ from system settings would cause flashing lights during cinematic moments.

notes.title: Speedball - Play Now on Steam Early Access
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277808/6b0c7d9744097af92443632d0f88ba361462425c.jpg
Speedball is a brand-new entry into the legendary Bitmap Brothers series! In the grim future of 2138, the futuresport is used by mega-corporations to distract the downtrodden masses from their miserable lives.

View the Early Access Launch trailer for Speedball here: 
[previewyoutube=ounULwbm2K4;full][/previewyoutube]
Once an underground sport reviled for its brutality, Speedball has risen to unprecedented heights of popularity and profitability. 

It is the only sport that allows two cybernetically augmented teams to go head-to-head at levels of speed and violence beyond human limitations, where any moment could be a player’s last.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806657/2d8826e2dca2d2b5ffc8183d228fbc1e4dfe53bc.png
BRUTALITY

Listen to the roar of the crowd and the crunch of broken bones as you engage in a brutal match-up with visceral takedowns. 
Sit back and watch as medbots drag your battered, beaten and bruised opponents out of the arena. 

SPEED

Whether playing singleplayer, online, or against a friend in couch play, matches are fast-paced, explosive and unpredictable. Master high-speed passing, coordination and shooting to climb your way the top of the underground world of Speedball.

STRATEGY

Select, position and organise your players based on their strengths, weaknesses and cybernetic augmentations. Will you push for all-out aggression, or will a defensive powerhouse be your greatest asset? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806657/cd9051eca76eb674d033ad0efdbba92fc5bae695.png
Features:
•	Incredible fast-paced matches that are explosive and unpredictable
•	Face off in a brutal sport featuring a wide range of teams and arenas
•	Take advantage of arena specific obstacles and abilities to gain the upper hand against your opponents
•	Arcade-style matches come together with sports management strategy 
•	Organize a team that fits your playstyle based on their individual traits and talents 
•	Hone your skills against the AI and then compete online or against a friend locally

Speedball has launched into Early Access with a 12-month roadmap that will see a host of new content and features added before the ‘full version’ of the game is released.
